# Vendored ClipperLib

`clipper-lib-6.4.2.min.js` is the jsDelivr-minified distribution of
[`clipper-lib` 6.4.2](https://www.npmjs.com/package/clipper-lib), copied from
the existing OS temporary-directory cache on 2026-09-15.  It is used only by
offline test workers; production continues to load its configured dependency.
